description: Add zero28 platform support - 9 coverage gaps eliminated. zero28 mirrors tg5040 behavior (same A133P SoC, same Tina Linux, same WiFi paths). Added to: pak.json, Makefile PLATFORMS, launch.sh allowed_platforms/write_config paths, bin/service-off system.json group, bin/service-on wpa_supplicant block, README.md docs.

asi.hypothesis: Zero28 (Allwinner A133P, Tina Linux) mirrors tg5040 WiFi implementation exactly - same SoC family, same OS, same wpa_supplicant paths
asi.rationale: Moss-zero28 uses the same Allwinner A133P SoC and Tina Linux as tg5040 (Trimui Smart Pro/Brick). The WiFi chipset is RTL8189ES via SDIO with nl80211 driver. All paths (/etc/wifi/wpa_supplicant.conf, /mnt/UDISK/system.json, etc.) are identical to tg5040.

description: Extract shared platform utilities into bin/lib/platform.sh, eliminating triplicated architecture/PATH/system_json_path across bin/service-off, bin/service-on, bin/wifi-enabled. Fix 4 unused loop variable warnings (SC2034). All shells pass with zero warnings at --severity=warning.

asi.hypothesis: Extract duplicated platform-to-path mappings into shared library to eliminate triplication and make future platform additions safer
asi.structural_improvement: Created bin/lib/platform.sh with normalize_platform, has_system_json, get_system_json_path, set_system_json, get_system_json, has_custom_wpa_template, get_wpa_template_path
asi.code_deleted: Removed ~30 lines of duplicated boilerplate (architecture detection, PATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH, system.json path mapping, wpa template selection) from 3 scripts
asi.future_impact: Adding a new platform now requires changes to platform.sh + one wpa_supplicant branch in service-on, instead of touching 4+ files with duplicated patterns
next_ideas: Could also extract wpa_supplicant startup into platform.sh get_wpa_startup_block()
Could codify the platform family concept (a133=tg5040/zero28, sigmastar=miyoomini/my282/my355, anbernic=rg35xxplus)
